question: NH₄Cl is the chemical formula for which of the following elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ammonium Chloride.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NH₄Cl** is the chemical formula for **Ammonium Chloride.**
 
• **Ammonium Chloride** is a **white crystalline salt **commonly used in **fertilizers, soldering fluxes,** and in the manufacturing of** dry cell batteries.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 -** Silicon Dioxide is a compound made up of **silicon and oxygen** and has the chemical formula **SiO2.**

 
 
• It is commonly found in nature as quartz and is used in the production of** glass, ceramics, and electronics.**
 
 
 
• **Option 2 **- Potassium Nitrate is a chemical compound with the formula **KNO**₃.
 
 
• It is commonly used as a **fertilizer, food preservative**, and in the manufacturing of **gunpowder.**
 
 
 
• **Option 3 **- Carbonyl Dichloride is a** chemical compound **with the formula** COCl2**.
 
 
• It is a** colorless liquid **used in the production of **pesticides, plastics, and pharmaceuticals.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the **correct **answer is option 4 - Ammonium Chloride.
